title: Display panel and display device
abstract: The invention discloses a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises an optical component area and a conventional display area; the substrate comprises a plurality of pixels, each pixel comprises a light-emitting device and a pixel driving circuit which are electrically connected; the light emitting device includes a first light emitting device and a second light emitting device; the conventional display area is provided with a first light-emitting device; the optical component area is provided with a second light emitting device; the optical component region includes a first optical component region and a second optical component region; the first optical member region includes a first light-transmitting region and a plurality of first light-shielding regions; the first light-shielding region covers at least one second light-emitting device; the second optical component area comprises a second light-transmitting area and a plurality of second light-shielding areas; the second light-shielding region covers at least one second light-emitting device; the first light-shielding area and the second light-shielding area have no parallel edges. The technical scheme provided by the invention can enhance the imaging effect of the photosensitive element area of the display panel.

title: Optical device
abstract: With a simple configuration, an optical device which realizes uniform light distribution and adequate display quality is provided. An optical device includes: a light guiding layer; a first optically functional layer provided on at least one of a first principal face and a second principal face of the light guiding layer; and a ray control structure, at an end of the light guiding layer on a light-incident side, being provided on a surface of the first optically functional layer that is on an opposite side to the light guiding layer. The ray control structure reduces light which is incident from an edge of the light guiding layer to the first optically functional layer at an angle smaller than a critical angle.

title: Optical sensing device and electronic apparatus having the same
abstract: An optical sensing device includes a substrate, a sensing element layer, a light-shielding layer and a light absorbing layer. The substrate has a first surface and a second surface opposite to the first surface. The sensing element layer is disposed on the first surface and includes a plurality of sensing elements. The light-shielding layer is disposed on the sensing element layer and has a plurality of openings, wherein an orthogonal projection of the opening on the substrate is overlapped with an orthogonal projection of the sensing element on the substrate. The light absorbing layer is disposed on the second surface. An electronic apparatus including the optical sensing device described above is also provided.

title: Display panel, manufacturing method thereof and display device
abstract: The invention provides a display panel, a manufacturing method thereof and a display device, wherein ambient light can be collected through a hollow part of a light conducting layer, and after the ambient light is totally reflected at an interface between a second refraction layer and a first refraction layer and an interface between the second refraction layer and a third refraction layer, the ambient light is led out to a photosensitive element through a light leading-out opening. Therefore, the invention can achieve the purpose of flexibly setting the placement position of the photosensitive element only by optimizing the position of the light guide outlet of the light conduction layer.

title: Optical film, backlight module and display device
abstract: An optical film, a backlight module and a display device are provided. The optical film is configured to receive and guide light. The optical film comprises a body and a plurality of optical structures. The body is provided with a light-emitting surface, an optical surface, a first side surface and a second side surface. The light-emitting surface is opposite to the optical surface, and the first side surface and the second side surface are respectively connected to two opposite side edges of the light-emitting surface and the optical surface. The optical structure is disposed on the first region of the optical surface. Each optical structure has a first surface and a second surface. The first surface and the optical surface form a first included angle. The first surface is a light receiving surface. The second surface is connected to the first surface. The second surface and the optical surface form a second included angle. The first included angle of the optical structure is gradually changed along a first direction from the first side surface to the second side surface.

title: Air supply arrangement and dust catcher
abstract: The invention provides an air supply device and a dust collector, wherein the air supply device is provided with an air supply outlet and comprises a rotating shaft, an impeller arranged on the rotating shaft and a diffuser positioned on one side of the impeller, which is far away from the air supply outlet; the diffuser comprises a base and a plurality of stationary blades which are convexly arranged on the outer ring surface of the base at intervals along the circumferential direction; the rack is fittingly installed at one end of the diffuser, which is far away from the diffuser, and a convex block which is convex towards the diffuser is arranged between the inner wall surface of the outer cylinder and the outer wall surface of the inner cylinder; the lug and the adjacent stationary blade are arranged at intervals relatively to form a flow guide channel, and the flow guide channel gradually turns to the outer wall surface of the inner barrel in the direction from the impeller to the rack. According to the technical scheme, the air flow can be effectively guided, so that direct impact of the air flow on components such as the motor is reduced, the flow loss can be reduced, the efficiency of the air supply device is improved, and the power consumption is reduced.

title: Chemical material mixing device
abstract: The invention discloses a chemical material mixing device, which belongs to the technical field of chemical production and comprises a storage tank, wherein a feed pipe is arranged at the top of the storage tank, a discharge pipe is arranged at the bottom of the storage tank, a second mixing mechanism for heating and mixing materials is arranged at the bottom of the storage tank, a first mixing mechanism for heating and mixing materials and for driving the second mixing mechanism is arranged at the top of the storage tank, the first mixing mechanism comprises a hollow transmission pipe, a plurality of hollow mixing plates are arranged at the bottom of the hollow transmission pipe, and a protective shell corresponding to the storage tank is rotatably connected at the top of the hollow transmission pipe; the invention has simple structure and convenient use, and can quickly and fully mix materials without dead angles by mutually matching a plurality of structures when in use, so that the mixing effect of the mixing device on the materials is better.

title: Water inlet device and high-speed mixed bed
abstract: The invention discloses a water inlet device and a high-speed mixing bed, wherein the water inlet device comprises a water inlet pipe, an exhaust pipe, a filtering device and a water distribution device, the water inlet pipe is used for being connected with a water inlet of the high-speed mixing bed, and a water inlet valve is arranged on the water inlet pipe; the water inlet pipe is also connected with a mounting pipe, the exhaust pipe is connected above the mounting pipe, and an exhaust valve is arranged on the exhaust pipe; the filtering device is positioned in the installation pipe and is used for filtering the resin entering the water inlet pipe; the water distribution device is arranged in the high-speed mixed bed and is provided with a plurality of water distribution holes which are uniformly distributed. Therefore, the filtering device is moved out of the tank body of the high-speed mixing bed, the problem that the water distribution plate is prone to serious deformation is solved with low cost, normal use of the high-speed mixing bed is guaranteed, water supply quality of a power station boiler is guaranteed, and safe and stable operation of a unit is guaranteed.

title: Material mixing device
abstract: The invention provides a material mixing device, which relates to the technical field of material mixing, and comprises: support, outer barrel, interior barrel and transfer line are provided with conveying mechanism on the support, outer barrel installs on the support, outer barrel top opening, and the bottom is the toper structure, the relief valve is installed to the bottom, interior barrel installs inside outer barrel, restrict out first cavity between interior barrel and the outer barrel, first cavity top has the feed inlet, supply conveying mechanism to send into in the first cavity with the material, first cavity below has the discharge gate, the discharge gate communicates with outer barrel bottom, and the discharge gate has and opens and close two kinds of states, transfer line installs in interior barrel, restrict out the second cavity between interior barrel and the transfer line, still be provided with the auger in the transfer line. The invention has the beneficial effects that: can realize abundant mixing to the material, the device loading rate is high simultaneously, and the energy consumption is also lower.

title: Device for detecting atmospheric microorganisms
abstract: The invention discloses a device for detecting atmospheric microorganisms in the technical field of environmental monitoring, which comprises a sealing tank, a supporting plate and an electric push rod, wherein the sealing tank and the electric push rod are respectively and fixedly connected to the right and left sides of the top of the supporting plate vertically, a liquid discharge pipe with a manual valve is arranged at the lower part of the right side of the outer wall of the sealing tank in a penetrating and communicating manner, a gas collecting device is horizontally welded at the top of the electric push rod, a first exhaust fan is fixedly connected to the upper part of the left side of the outer wall of the sealing tank through a horizontal welding bracket, an air inlet of the first exhaust fan is connected with an air outlet of the gas collecting device through a hose, DTT liquid is placed in the sealing tank, when monitoring is not needed, an inert gas recycling device is used for releasing inert gas to fill the sealing tank to prevent oxidation, when the air is needed to be used, the air is injected, meanwhile, the inert gas is recycled, the change rate of a PH (potential of hydrogen) meter is observed for digital display, and the air quality is judged, the device is convenient to operate and use in multiple environments.

title: Thermoplastic composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a thermoplastic composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the thermoplastic composite material comprises a surface layer material and a framework material; the surface layer material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of high-fluidity polypropylene resin, 45-50 parts of untwisted continuous glass fiber, 1-8 parts of compatilizer, 0.5-1 part of lubricant, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-8 parts of highlight improver and 1-2 parts of carbon black; the framework material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-35 parts of medium-high fluidity polypropylene resin, 50-70 parts of untwisted continuous glass fiber, 1-8 parts of compatilizer, 0.5-1 part of lubricant, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-12 parts of low warpage improver and 1-2 parts of carbon black. The thermoplastic composite material provided by the invention has good mechanical properties, high surface gloss, high strength, low warpage and high temperature resistance, meets the requirements of automobile engine hood cover materials, and realizes the light weight of automobiles.

title: Composite membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a composite membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite membrane at least comprises a substrate layer, a coating layer and a coating layer, wherein the substrate layer is made of polyolefin, the coating layer is arranged on one side of the substrate layer, the material of the coating layer comprises elastomer and nano particles, and the median pore diameter in the coating layer is smaller than that in the substrate layer. The composite film, the preparation method and the application thereof can ensure that the garment fabric has excellent moisture permeability and water resistance, thereby improving the comfort and durability of the garment fabric.

title: Adhesive, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an adhesive, a preparation method and application thereof. The adhesive consists of a component A, a component B and a component C, wherein the component A comprises 5-15 parts of multifunctional epoxy resin, 3-10 parts of bio-based modified epoxy resin, 0.5-2.5 parts of environment-friendly reactive diluent, 0.2-0.6 part of silane coupling agent, 0.6-2.4 parts of thixotropic agent, the component B comprises 2-6 parts of amine curing agent, 1.5-4 parts of bio-based phenolic amine curing agent, 0.5-2 parts of accelerator, 40-60 parts of high-strength high-modulus inert filler and 0.2-0.4 part of environment-friendly pigment, the component C comprises 10-30 parts of surface active filler, and A, B, C parts of independent package and are mixed according to the weight ratio of 1:3:1 for use during construction. The adhesive provided by the invention can realize the cooperative unification of the low-temperature construction performance and the normal-temperature high-strength performance, and can give consideration to the bonding performance, the rheological performance and the high-strength characteristic under the normal-temperature and low-temperature conditions.

title: Resin composition, composite adhesive film, copper-clad plate and preparation and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a resin composition, which comprises thermosetting polyphenyl ether and modified filler, wherein the thermosetting polyphenyl ether is obtained by carrying out redistribution reaction and hydroxyl-terminated acrylation modification on thermoplastic polyphenyl ether, and the modified filler is obtained by carrying out surface modification on inorganic powder by adopting a double bond-containing silane coupling agent. The invention also discloses a composite adhesive film comprising the resin composition, a polyphenyl ether-based copper-clad plate and application thereof. The invention greatly improves the compatibility between the interfaces of the composite materials, improves the uniformity of the filler in the matrix, and the obtained product has excellent dielectric property and flexibility and good peel strength.

title: Wear-resistant resin matrix composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a wear-resistant resin matrix composite material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of composite material preparation, wherein the composite material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-50 parts of thermosetting resin, 5-10 parts of curing agent, 0.6-1 part of lubricant, 3-8 parts of flame retardant and 1-3 parts of filler; the lubricant is silicone oil, and the curing agent is any one of phthalic anhydride, pyromellitic dianhydride, tetrahydrophthalic anhydride and maleic anhydride. According to the wear-resistant resin-based composite material and the preparation method thereof, the wear resistance of the composite material can be obviously improved by adding the modified silicon carbide whisker, and meanwhile, the interface bonding strength of the silicon carbide whisker and the resin matrix can be improved by modifying the silicon carbide whisker through the silane coupling agent, so that the mechanical property of the composite material is improved; meanwhile, the flame retardant performance of the composite material can be effectively improved and the safety of the composite material in use under the high-temperature condition can be improved by adding the flame retardant.

title: Electrical structure and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate; a first insulation layer disposed over a first surface of the substrate; a second insulation layer disposed on the first insulation layer; and an electrical contact extending through the first and second insulation layers to electrically connect to the first surface of the substrate. The electrical contact includes a first portion disposed in the first insulation layer and a second portion disposed in the second insulation layer, the first portion has a first width, the second portion has a second width, and a ratio of a difference between the first width and the second width to the first width is less than 10%; at least one isolation feature extending into the substrate and disposed below the first surface of the substrate; and at least one conductive feature extending through the second insulation layer and the first insulation layer and into the substrate.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: There is provided a semiconductor device including a semiconductor chip including a first main surface and a second main surface opposite to the first main surface, an element region formed on the first main surface and including an element part, and a non-element region outside the element region, an insulating layer covering the element region and the non-element region, a first pad formed on the insulating layer and electrically connected to the element part, a second pad formed on the insulating layer and electrically connected to the element part via a path electrically separated from the first pad, a first uneven structure formed by a buried body, which has conductivity and is buried in the insulating layer, below the first pad of the insulating layer, and a second uneven structure formed by deposits deposited on a surface of the insulating layer, below the second pad of the insulating layer.

title: Electronic device and method for manufacturing electronic device
abstract: An electronic device includes a substrate having a recessed portion on a first surface; a first superconducting wiring having a portion in contact with the first surface; a second superconducting wiring intersecting the first superconducting wiring in a plan view above the recessed portion and having a portion in contact with the first surface; an insulating film provided between the first superconducting wiring and the second superconducting wiring; and a first support member provided in the recessed portion and supporting at least one of the first superconducting wiring or the second superconducting wiring, wherein a hollow portion is formed between a region where the first superconducting wiring and the second superconducting wiring intersect in a plan view and a bottom surface of the recessed portion.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method of semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes: a first gate structure including first conductive layers and first insulating layers alternately stacked; a separation insulating layer located in the first gate structure and including a first line part extending in a first direction, first protrusions protruding from the first line part to one side, and second protrusions protruding from the line part to the other side; first memory patterns surrounding the first protrusions, respectively; and first protective patterns located between the first line part and the first memory patterns, respectively.

title: Semiconductor device having transistor device of three-dimensional structure
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate, a bit line conductive layer extending in a lateral direction substantially parallel to a surface of the substrate, a first insulation line structure extending in a second direction that is perpendicular to the first lateral direction and that is substantially parallel to the surface of the substrate, first and second channel structures that are disposed to respectively contact first and second sides of the first insulation line structure and that partially overlap with the bit line conductive layer, first and second gate dielectric layers respectively disposed over the substrate and on side surfaces of the first and second channel structures, and first and second gate line conductive layers extending in the second lateral direction over the substrate and covering at least a portion of each of the first and second gate dielectric layers, respectively.

title: Treatment of cancer using chimeric antigen receptor
abstract: The present invention provides compositions and methods for treating diseases associated with expression of cancer-associated antigens as described herein. The invention also relates to Chimeric Antigen Receptors (CARs) specific for cancer-associated antigens as described herein, vectors encoding the same, and recombinant T cells comprising the CARs of the invention. The invention also includes a method of administering a genetically modified T cell expressing a CAR comprising an antigen binding domain that binds to a cancer-associated antigen as described herein.

title: Human monoclonal antibodies to programmed death 1 (pd-1) and methods for treating cancer using anti-pd-1 antibodies alone or in combination with other immunotherapeutics
abstract: The present invention provides isolated monoclonal antibodies, particularly human monoclonal antibodies, that specifically bind to PD-1 with high affinity. Nucleic acid molecules encoding the antibodies of the invention, expression vectors, host cells and methods for expressing the antibodies of the invention are also provided. Immunoconjugates, bispecific molecules and pharmaceutical compositions comprising the antibodies of the invention are also provided. The invention also provides methods for detecting PD-1, as well as methods for treating various diseases, including cancer and infectious diseases, using anti-PD-1 antibodies. The present invention further provides methods for using a combination immunotherapy, such as the combination of anti- CTLA-4 and anti-PD-1 antibodies, to treat hyperproliferative disease, such as cancer. The invention also provides methods for altering adverse events related to treatment with such antibodies individually.

title: Cell therapy methods.
abstract: The present invention is in the field of cell therapy and provides compositions and methods for treating cancer and/or viral infections in patients. The invention provides lymphocytes comprising a synthetic polynucleotide encoding at least one iron regulatory protein and, optionally, a chimeric antigen receptor. The invention further provides methods for producing these lymphocytes and administering them to patients.

title: Diagnosis and therapy of cancer involving cancer stem cells
abstract: The present invention provides methods for diagnosis or treatment of cancer diseases involving cancer stem cells comprising targeting CLDN6. In particular, the present invention provides a method of determining cancer stem cells comprising detecting cells expressing CLDN6. Furthermore, the present invention provides a method of treating or preventing cancer comprising inhibiting and/or eliminating cancer stem cells by administering an antibody having the ability of binding to CLDN6 to a cancer patient.

title: Novel peptides & combination of peptides as targets or active ingredients for use in immunotherapy against aml & other cancers
abstract: The present invention relates to peptides, proteins, nucleic acids and cells for use in immunotherapeutic methods. In particular, the present invention relates to the immunotherapy of cancer. The present invention furthermore relates to tumor-associated T-cell peptide epitopes, alone or in combination with other tumor-associated peptides that can for example serve as active pharmaceutical ingredients of vaccine compositions that stimulate anti-tumor immune responses, or to stimulate T cells ex vivo and transfer into patients. Peptides bound to molecules of the major histocompatibility complex (MHC), or peptides as such, can also be targets of antibodies, soluble T-cell receptors, and other binding molecules.

title: Control circuit, control method and display device
abstract: The application provides a control circuit, a control method and a display device. The control circuit comprises a sampling module, a switching module and a working power supply, wherein the sampling module is used for collecting level signals corresponding to pulse width modulation signals, one end of the switching module is connected with the sampling module, the other end of the switching module is connected with at least one group of signal feedback ends, each signal feedback end comprises at least two feedback points, each feedback point is connected with a light-emitting unit, and the switching module can switch between a first mode and a second mode based on the relation between the level signals and a preset threshold value; in the first mode, the switching module can control each feedback point in the signal feedback end to be independent; in the second mode, the switching module can control each feedback point in the signal feedback end to be related to each other; the working power supply is connected with the sampling module and the switching module and supplies power to the sampling module and the switching module. According to the technical scheme, continuous flicker of the light emitting diode can be reduced when the PWM signal of the low level signal is generated.

title: Power supply device and control method thereof
abstract: The application provides a power supply device and a control method thereof, and relates to the field of communication. The power supply device includes: the power supply system comprises a direct current input power supply end, an alternating current input power supply end, a first power supply module and a second power supply module; the input end of the first power supply module is connected with the direct current input power supply end, the output end of the first power supply module is connected with the power receiving load, the input end of the second power supply module is connected with the alternating current input power supply end, and the output end of the second power supply module is connected with the power receiving load; the first power supply module is used for detecting the power supply state of the direct current input power supply end; the second power supply module is used for acquiring the power supply state of the direct current input power supply end from the first power supply module, determining the power supply proportion of the second power supply module to the power receiving load according to the power supply state of the direct current input power supply end, fully meeting the user requirements, better realizing the uninterrupted power supply of the power supply device, and simultaneously improving the flexibility and configurability of the power supply device, thereby improving the reliability of the power supply device.

title: Signal processing circuit and signal processing device
abstract: The invention discloses a signal processing circuit and a signal processing device, comprising: the signal reading module comprises a detection transistor, a reference transistor, a voltage following unit and a signal acquisition unit; the voltage following unit is respectively and electrically connected with the first current source, the drain electrode of the detection transistor, the drain electrode of the reference transistor, the source electrode of the detection transistor, the source electrode of the reference transistor and the signal acquisition unit; the source electrode of the detection transistor and the source electrode of the reference transistor are also electrically connected with a second current source; the differential amplification module is electrically connected with the signal acquisition unit; the differential amplification module takes the acquired source voltage of the detection transistor as a detection voltage signal and the source voltage of the reference transistor as a reference voltage signal, and performs signal amplification to output a detection result after the amplified detection voltage signal and the amplified reference voltage signal are differentiated, so that the influence of environment and temperature on the detection transistor is eliminated, and the problem that the ion concentration is difficult to accurately detect is solved.

title: Receiver control circuit and terminal
abstract: Disclosed are a receiver control circuit and a terminal. The receiver control circuit includes: a smart power amplifier module, a coder-decoder, and a receiver. The smart power amplifier module is electrically connected to the receiver by a first switch module. The first switch module includes a first switch component unit that is formed by a metal oxide semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET). The first switch module further includes a first follower unit, where the first follower unit is configured to keep an unchanged voltage difference between a gate electrode of the MOSFET of the first switch component unit and a drain electrode thereof, and a gate electrode voltage of the MOSFET of the first switch component unit is greater than a drain electrode voltage thereof. The coder-decoder is electrically connected to the receiver by the second switch module. The second switch module includes a second switch component unit.

title: Systems and methods for controlling inverter having shutoff circuit
abstract: A system includes: a control board comprising: a microprocessor configured to output a PWM signal; a primary shutoff path circuit, an upper MOSFET shutoff circuit, and a lower MOSFET shutoff circuit, wherein each of the circuits is configured to receive the PWM signal; a first buffer provided at an output of the primary shutoff path circuit; a second buffer provided at an output of the upper MOSFET shutoff circuit; a third buffer provided at an output of the lower MOSFET shutoff circuit; a first resistor and a second resistor provided in parallel at the first buffer and configured to provide a first feedback signal; a third resistor and a fourth resistor provided in parallel at the second buffer and configured to provide a second feedback signal; and a fifth resistor and a sixth resistor provided in parallel at the third buffer and configured to provide a third feedback signal.

title: Vehicle control method, apparatus, vehicle, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle control method, a device, a vehicle and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a vehicle detects a ramp identifier, determining whether the vehicle starts a navigation system; if the vehicle does not start a navigation system, acquiring lane line information corresponding to the vehicle; determining whether the vehicle is traveling in a ramp direction based on the lane line information; if it is determined that the vehicle is traveling in the ramp direction, and acquiring ramp speed limit information corresponding to the ramp identification, and outputting the ramp speed limit information. According to the method and the device, whether the vehicle runs towards the ramp direction or not is accurately determined through the lane line information, and the ramp speed limit information is output when the vehicle runs towards the ramp direction, so that the situations of error display and display omission of the ramp speed limit information when the vehicle without starting a navigation system enters the ramp are greatly reduced, and the safety of the vehicle running into the ramp is improved through accurately outputting the ramp speed limit information.

title: Vehicle speed control system
abstract: The present invention relates to a speed control system and a speed control method. The present invention may comprise: a cognition device configured to provide sensing information by sensing an object outside of a host vehicle; a route setting device configured to receive updated map information from the outside of the host vehicle to update a map, plan a driving route to a destination set by a driver, based on the map, and provide information on the planned driving route as driving route information; an offline driving control unit configured to generate, when it is determined that a preceding vehicle in front of the host vehicle is traveling in the driving route of the host vehicle on the basis of the sensing information and the driving route information of the host vehicle, a driving route of the preceding vehicle and generate offline driving control information on the basis of the driving route of the preceding vehicle; and a vehicle control output interface configured to provide the offline driving control information to an engine control system, a braking control system, and a steering control system. According to the present invention, it is possible to increase safety in vehicle driving.

title: Vehicle control method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a control method and a control device for a vehicle. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: collecting the running state parameters of a target vehicle, wherein the target vehicle runs according to a preset planned route, and the planned route comprises the following steps: longitudinal planning and transverse planning; judging whether to change the transverse planning of the target vehicle based on a target control strategy according to the driving state parameters, wherein the target control strategy is selected from a plurality of preset candidate control strategies; and continuing to control the target vehicle to run according to the judgment result. The invention solves the technical problem of lower automation degree of the unmanned automobile in the prior art.

title: Equipment monitoring system and method
abstract: The invention provides a device monitoring system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an equipment scheduling module, a plurality of data transmission units and a monitoring management module; the equipment scheduling module is used for acquiring the target production task work order from the manufacturing execution system and issuing equipment task information corresponding to the target production task work order to the target equipment; the data transmission units are used for acquiring monitoring data of the target equipment and sending the monitoring data of the target equipment to the monitoring management module; and the monitoring management module is used for generating at least one of alarm information, a target report and a target billboard based on the monitoring data of the target equipment. The equipment monitoring system and the method provided by the invention can realize real-time monitoring of the equipment driven by the scheduling work order by taking the MES as the drive through the equipment scheduling module, can provide a more effective solution for efficient management and monitoring of the equipment, and can provide a more effective way for realizing unmanned factory and automatic production.

title: Control method and control system for automatic driving vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a control method and a control system for an automatic driving vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current position information of the vehicle, an automatic driving path and lane line length information on two sides in front; determining whether critical obstacles exist in front of the vehicle according to the length information, if so, acquiring the position information of the critical obstacles, judging whether the critical obstacles influence the traffic of the vehicle according to the current position information of the vehicle, the position information of the critical obstacles and the automatic driving path, and sending a control instruction to the vehicle according to the judging result. According to the invention, whether the critical obstacle exists or not is judged by utilizing the shielding state of the lane line, on the basis, whether the critical obstacle influences the traffic of the vehicle is further judged by combining the current position information of the vehicle, the position information of the critical obstacle and the automatic driving path, the obtained result is accurate, the false braking rate and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents are reduced, and the driving safety of the automatic driving vehicle can be greatly improved.

title: Protective device for machining mechanical equipment
abstract: The utility model relates to a protective device for machining mechanical equipment, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a movable wheel is arranged at the bottom end of the supporting plate, a lifting groove is formed in the supporting plate, a lifting plate is arranged in the lifting groove in a lifting adjustable manner, a lifting adjusting structure is arranged between the lifting plate and the supporting plate, an observation window is arranged on the lifting plate, a collecting box is arranged below the inner side wall of the supporting plate, a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the collecting box in an outward extending manner, a spiral discharging shaft is arranged in the collecting box through a bearing and matched with the discharging pipe, a driving piece is arranged on the collecting box in a transmission connection with the spiral discharging shaft, an electromagnet is arranged on the inner wall of the supporting plate in a matched manner, and the electromagnet is connected with a power supply structure.

title: Safety auxiliary device
abstract: The utility model discloses a safety auxiliary device, which comprises a fixed plate; the front surface of the fixing plate is rotatably provided with an extension mechanism, the front surface of the extension mechanism is fixedly provided with a support frame, one end of the inner wall of the support frame is fixedly provided with an anti-falling mechanism, the inside of the support frame is rotatably provided with a winding mechanism, and the outer side of the winding mechanism is wound with a safety rope main body; the extending mechanism comprises a bidirectional screw rod, a sleeve, a connecting rod and a connecting seat; according to the utility model, the bidirectional screw, the sleeve, the connecting rods and the connecting seat are matched for use, the sleeve can be driven to move by the rotation of the bidirectional screw, when the opening and closing angles of the two groups of connecting rods on the front of the sleeve are maximum, the supporting frame can be positioned on the front of the fixed plate, the device is stored, the occupied space is reduced, and when the opening and closing angles of the two groups of connecting rods on the front of the sleeve are reduced, one end of each connecting rod can be driven to drive the supporting frame to extend out for use, so that the device is beneficial to personnel.

title: Supporting device for compressor installation
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of compressor support devices and discloses a supporting device for installing a compressor, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein the tops of the left end and the right end of the fixed plate are respectively and rotatably connected with a connecting plate, the left end and the right end of the bottom end of the fixed plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a rotating plate, the opposite end of the rotating plate is rotatably connected with a loading plate, the rear end of the inner wall of the loading plate is fixedly connected with a heat dissipation assembly, the left side and the right side of the loading plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the inner wall of the right supporting plate is rotatably connected with a first screw rod, the inner wall of the right supporting plate is fixedly connected with a first sliding rod, and the top of the front end of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a fixed pipe. In the utility model, the inclination angle of the compressor can be conveniently changed, the compressor can be parallel to the ground, stable support is provided, vibration and shaking of the compressor during operation can be reduced, heat can be conveniently and freely emitted to the surrounding environment, and adverse effects of heat accumulation on the performance and service life of the compressor are reduced.

title: Mechanical part machining clamping table
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining of mechanical parts, in particular to a clamping table for machining of mechanical parts, which comprises a lifting table, a base and an operating table; the lifting table is arranged above the base; the operating platform is arranged above the lifting platform, the lifting platform is provided with a rotating seat, and the lifting platform is provided with a power component A for driving the rotating seat to horizontally rotate; the bottom end of the operating table is fixedly connected with a rotating seat, the rotating seat is rotationally connected with the rotating seat through a mounting shaft, and a power assembly B for driving the mounting shaft to rotate is arranged on the lifting table; the upper end of the base is provided with a control button A, a control button B, a control button C and a control button D. According to the utility model, the horizontal rotation of the rotating seat and the up-and-down rotation of the operating table can be controlled in a stepping manner, so that the processing angle of a workpiece can be conveniently adjusted, two hands are liberated, and the working efficiency is improved.

title: Hardware bending device for hardware production
abstract: The utility model discloses a hardware bending device for hardware production, which comprises a frame body, a processing table, a shaping assembly, a pressing assembly and a grid blocking piece, wherein the processing table is provided with an auxiliary assembly, the shaping assembly comprises an L-shaped support fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the processing table, a swinging plate is arranged at the top of the L-shaped support, the swinging plate and the L-shaped support are rotatably arranged through bearings, the shaping assembly comprises a sleeve fixedly arranged in the middle of the processing table, and the shaping mold is provided with the grid blocking piece for blocking reinforcing steel bars. Through setting up subassembly and design subassembly exert pressure, utilize the conical advantage in design mould top, cooperate its lift regulatory function, can buckle the operation to the type of bending of multiple difference, utilize this mode, the staff need not frequently to change the design mould, still reduced the work degree of difficulty of staff when improving whole machining efficiency, in addition, through setting up the check and keep off the piece on the design mould, can intercept and stabilize the reinforcing bar in the folding process.

title: Heating device and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a heating device and a control method thereof, wherein the heating device comprises: the air suction and blowing assembly is used for enabling the substrate to be suspended on the heating plate and comprises a plurality of air suction holes, a plurality of air blowing holes, an air suction pipeline and an air blowing pipeline; the air blowing component is connected with the air blowing pipeline; the air blowing component is used for introducing air with set temperature into the air blowing pipeline; at least one temperature sensor for detecting a temperature of a gas within the process chamber; and the temperature regulator is used for regulating the temperature of the gas introduced into the gas blowing part according to the temperature detected by the temperature sensor so as to keep the temperature in the process chamber constant. The heating device and the control method thereof can improve the heating effect and the product yield.

title: Heating unit and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a heating unit and a control method thereof, wherein the unit comprises: the device comprises a compressor (1), a condenser (2), a reversing mechanism and two evaporators; the condenser (2) and the reversing mechanism are sequentially and adaptively connected in a refrigerant circulation loop between the exhaust end of the compressor (1) and the suction end of the compressor (1); the two evaporators are respectively connected to the refrigerant circulation loop in an adaptive manner through the reversing mechanism and are used for realizing the switching defrosting of two heating modes through the reversing of the reversing mechanism. The scheme of the invention can overcome the defects of poor heating stability, large defrosting difficulty, poor user experience and the like in the prior art, and realize the beneficial effects of good heating stability, small defrosting difficulty and good user experience.

title: Temperature-controllable double-step cooling and dry distillation device and using method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a temperature-controllable double-step cooling and dry distillation device and a using method thereof, and the device comprises a boiler, a boiler cover, a first pipeline, a first collecting tank, a second pipeline, a condensing tank, a second collecting tank, a smoke extractor and a frame, wherein the boiler is connected with the boiler cover through bolts, an electric furnace tray and a material basket are installed in the boiler, a thermometer is fixedly installed on the wall of the boiler, one end of the first pipeline penetrates through the boiler cover to be communicated with the boiler, the other end of the first pipeline is communicated with the first collecting tank, the first collecting tank is communicated with one end of the condensing tank through the second pipeline, the other end of the condensing tank is communicated with the second collecting tank through a third pipeline, and the second collecting tank is communicated with the smoke extractor through a fourth pipeline. The electric furnace plate with the adjustable heating temperature heats materials, the temperature in the furnace can be heated to 800 ℃, dry distillation can be carried out on different materials, the rotating speeds of a smoke extractor and a cooling fan are adjusted, zero emission of waste gas can be realized, and distillate generated by the dry distillation of a radiator and a cooling tank is cooled twice, so that the distillate generated by the dry distillation is cooled as far as possible to form dry distillation liquid.

title: Heat collector heating system and method utilizing compressed air to store energy
abstract: The invention discloses a heat collector heating system and a method utilizing compressed air to store energy, wherein the system comprises a heat taking unit, a heat supplementing unit, a heat storage unit and a heating unit, the heat taking unit comprises a cooling tower, a waste heat water supply main pipeline and a waste heat water return main pipeline, the waste heat water supply main pipeline and the waste heat water return main pipeline are communicated with the cooling tower, the heat supplementing unit comprises a solar heat collector and a positive displacement heat exchanger, the primary side of the positive displacement heat exchanger is communicated with the solar heat collector, the secondary side of the positive displacement heat exchanger is communicated with the waste heat water supply main pipeline and the waste heat water return main pipeline, the heat storage unit comprises a waste heat storage tank, the waste heat storage tank is communicated with the positive displacement heat exchanger, the heating unit comprises a water source heat pump unit, the low-temperature side of the water source heat pump unit is respectively communicated with the waste heat storage tank and the positive displacement heat exchanger, and the high-temperature side of the water source heat pump unit is communicated with a heating pipe network outside a factory area or a factory area. The invention improves the energy utilization efficiency, reduces the operation cost and reduces the consumption of non-renewable energy sources.

title: Heating and ventilation system applied to thermal power plant
abstract: The invention discloses a heating and ventilating system applied to a thermal power plant, which comprises a heat exchange water bath furnace, a plurality of heat exchange sheets arranged in the heat exchange water bath furnace, a heat exchange control valve arranged at the front end of each heat exchange sheet, a heating and ventilating pipeline connected with the heat exchange water bath furnace, a circulating pump arranged on the heating and ventilating pipeline, an inlet temperature sensor and a return water temperature sensor arranged at the upper inlet end and the return water end of the heating and ventilating pipeline, and a central controller used for controlling a steam control valve, the heat exchange control valve and the circulating pump; the invention firstly exchanges heat between the waste heat steam and the heat exchange water bath furnace, thereby avoiding the problems of overhigh heating temperature and difficult temperature adjustment caused by directly adopting the waste heat steam, and simultaneously, the invention realizes the switching of the number of the heat exchange control valves by reasonably and logically controlling the switching of different numbers of the heat exchange control valves through the central controller, thereby conveniently realizing the adjustment of the heating temperature and greatly improving the intelligence of the operation of the heating and ventilation system of the thermal power plant.

title: Air purifying treatment device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of air treatment, in particular to an air purification treatment device, which comprises an outer frame, wherein a water tank is arranged in the middle of the outer frame, and a filter plate is connected inside the outer frame through a plurality of groups of springs; a servo motor mounted on the surface of the outer frame; the rotating shaft is connected to the output end of the servo motor and extends to the inner wall of the outer frame; the striking block is arranged in the middle of the rotating shaft; the filling layers are arranged at two ends of the inner part of the outer frame, an air outlet is formed in the left filling layer, and an air inlet is formed in the right filling layer; and the sound absorbing plate is arranged around the inner wall of the outer frame. The utility model overcomes the defects of the prior art, reduces the blocking condition of the filter plate by arranging the servo motor, the spring and the collecting box, is convenient for the subsequent air passing rate, and reduces the occurrence of air flowing noise caused by mutual collision and friction with various obstacles in the entering device by arranging the filling layer and the sound absorbing plate.

title: Pellet dosing unit
abstract: The utility model discloses a pellet batching device which comprises a filtering bin, a blanking pipe, a mixing bin and a transmission shaft, wherein a heating layer is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the mixing bin, holes are formed in the two sides of the mixing bin, bearings are embedded in the holes, the inner walls of the two bearings are respectively and fixedly connected with the two ends of the outer wall of the transmission shaft, stirring fans are fixedly arranged on the transmission shaft in an annular array mode, the bottom end of the mixing bin is provided with a hole and is communicated and installed with the top end of the blanking pipe, the bottom end of the blanking pipe is communicated and installed with the top end of the filtering bin, and a control device body is fixedly arranged on the front face of the mixing bin through a connecting rod. The utility model solves the problems that a large amount of water vapor is stored in the mixed material, so that the pellets are difficult to form and the chemical reaction speed is reduced.

title: Kitchen garbage odor purification unit
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of gas treatment, in particular to a kitchen waste odor purification treatment device, which comprises a supporting seat; an outer shell and a purification box are arranged on the supporting seat, and a vent pipe is communicated between the outer shell and the purification box; the collecting pipe is rotatably arranged on the inner side of the outer shell, a partition plate is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the collecting pipe, an installation shaft is arranged on the partition plate, and a servo motor for driving the installation shaft to rotate is arranged on the outer shell; a discharge hole is formed in the supporting seat; a fixed pipe is arranged on the lower end face of the supporting seat, a threaded ring is arranged on the outer side of the fixed pipe, a plurality of sliding blocks are arranged on the threaded ring, and annular grooves for the sliding of the sliding blocks are formed in the outer side wall of the fixed pipe; the lower part of the fixed pipe is provided with a collecting box, and the threaded ring is in threaded connection with the upper part of the collecting box. The garbage storage device can prevent a large amount of bacteria and odor generated in garbage from flying into the air, and simultaneously prevent operators from directly observing the stored garbage and avoid generating uncomfortable feeling.

title: Ventilation heating device
abstract: The utility model discloses a ventilation heating device relates to heating pipe technical field. The utility model discloses a heating pipeline, filter screen frame and mounting panel, the terminal surface is provided with a plurality of second draw-in grooves before the mounting panel, heating pipeline rear end face fixed mounting has a plurality of card frames, card frame and second draw-in groove size are collocated mutually, heating pipeline passes through card frame and the cooperation of second draw-in groove joint with the mounting panel, the equal fixed mounting of both ends face has a plurality of first fixture blocks about heating pipeline is relative, a plurality of first draw-in grooves have all been opened to the both ends face about the filter screen frame, filter screen frame and heating pipeline size are the same, first draw-in groove and the cooperation of first fixture block joint. The utility model discloses a set up mounting panel, first fixture block, first draw-in groove and filter screen frame, reduced the extravagant interior space of heating pipe, be convenient for again clear up the inside dust and dirty of heating pipe, can let the user obtain clear warm braw, be of value to the respiratory tract health of user, increased indoor available space again simultaneously, had very good popularization prospect.

title: Energy-saving equipment
abstract: The utility model provides energy-saving equipment, which comprises an energy-saving box, wherein two supporting plates are arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the energy-saving box, ventilation grooves are formed in the two supporting plates, a water tank is arranged at the top of the two supporting plates, a water level sensor is arranged at the corner of the inner wall of the water tank, a ventilation hole is formed in the top of the water tank, and a transmission mechanism is communicated with the top of the energy-saving box in a sealing manner: when gas enters the energy-saving box, the gas firstly contacts the bottom of the water tank, the water tank is heated at high temperature, then the water tank is heated to be hot water, then the gas enters the top of the inner wall of the energy-saving box through the ventilation groove formed in the supporting plate, and enters the air delivery channel through the filter screen, and when the gas flows back from the air delivery channel, the power generation fan can be driven to rotate, then the power generated by the power generation fan is converted into electric power, the gas flows back to the boiler through the first connector for secondary use, and the utilization rate is improved.

title: Cell apoptosis inhibitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a cell apoptosis inhibitor, a preparation method and application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a compound, or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, hydrate or solvate thereof, wherein the compound is shown as a formula I. The invention also provides methods for preparing the compounds and pharmaceutical compositions containing them or their use in the treatment or prevention of diseases or conditions associated with cellular apoptosis and/or human receptor interacting protein 1 kinase (RIPK 1).

title: Compounds for treating proliferative diseases
abstract: The present disclosure provides compounds of Formula (I): (I). The compounds described herein may be useful in treating and/or preventing proliferative diseases (e.g., cancer). Also provided in the present disclosure are pharmaceutical compositions, kits, methods, and uses including or using a compound described herein.

title: Compound or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, pharmaceutical composition and application
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and particularly relates to a compound shown as a formula I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof; the invention also relates to a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and application thereof; the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof can be used for preventing or treating cancers and inhibiting or killing tumor cells;

title: Novel dihydropyrimidine compound, intermediate or salt, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The application discloses a compound shown in a formula (I), or stereoisomers, geometric isomers, tautomers, oxynitride compounds, hydrates, solvent compounds, metabolites, pharmaceutically acceptable salts and intermediates thereof. The application also provides application of the compound, stereoisomer or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof in preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing diseases related to the TRPA1 receptor, in particular to application in preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing cough, asthma, pain and sleep apnea.

title: Phenyl amide compounds and methods of use
abstract: The present application relates to compounds of Formula (I), as defined herein, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The present application also describes pharmaceutical composition comprising a compound of Formula (I), and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, and methods of using the compounds and compositions for inhibiting certain protein-protein interactions, and for treating cancer.

title: Improved method for preparation of protein-enriched products from plant material
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for preparation of protein-enriched products, such as plant protein isolates or protein-fibre formulations, from plant materials such as oilseeds, as well as to the uses of the products obtainable via said process in human food and/or animal feed. In particular, the presented herein processes advantageously make use of solvents based on low-boiling azeotropic mixtures made of an apolar and lipophilic organic ester having up to 5 carbon atoms, With an alcohol having up to 5 carbon atoms, which solvents not only make the need to use noxious hexane-based solvents obsolete, but also can undergo reutilisation cycles by being easily obtainable and recoverable from spent solvents and/or mother liquors as used in the presented herein processes, and consequently render the disclosed processes extremely energy-efficient, suitable for large-scale industrial production, as well as eco-friendly.

title: Preparation and application of organic extract of penicillium fermentation product for promoting plant growth
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an organic extract of penicillium fermentation product for promoting plant growth, relates to the field of biotechnology, and aims to separate effective components which can not promote plant growth from the penicillium fermentation product at present. The technical scheme includes that the organic extract of the penicillium fermentation product is obtained by drying the penicillium fermentation product at a high temperature of 100 ℃, adding methanol for extraction, then extracting with ethyl acetate, and separating the ethyl acetate extract with a silica gel column. The organic extract of the penicillium fermentation product for promoting plant growth, the preparation method and the application thereof provided by the invention have the advantages of simple operation and low cost, change the penicillium fermentation product into valuable, and realize the recycling of organic waste.

title: Vegetable seedling raising and strengthening microorganism composition, matrix and preparation method
abstract: The invention provides a vegetable seedling-raising and seedling-strengthening microbial composition, a matrix and a preparation method, and belongs to the technical field of microbial agents. The invention provides a microorganism composition for vegetable seedling culture, which comprises bacterial solutions of various bacteria, wherein the bacterial types of the bacteria comprise bacillus subtilis, bacillus amyloliquefaciens, paenibacillus polymyxa and azospirillum brasilense, and the bacteria have synergistic effects, so that the germination time of seeds can be obviously shortened, and the root length and the lateral root number can be improved. The invention also takes the microorganism composition as a basis, and the microorganism composition and the mushroom waste, the straw, the fresh livestock manure and the like are subjected to closed fermentation to prepare the substrate for vegetable seedling cultivation, so that seeds can be directly planted in the substrate for vegetable seedling cultivation, the germination time of the seeds can be further shortened, and statistics is carried out within the same time after germination.

title: Preparation method and application of plant source composite polysaccharide
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of plant source composite polysaccharide, and belongs to the technical field of plant source polysaccharide preparation. The plant source compound polysaccharide is prepared by extracting and separating polysaccharide in wrinkled papaya, crab apple and hawthorn seed, adding inulin, and then performing enzymolysis to decompose macromolecular polysaccharide into micromolecular saccharide with higher bioactivity. When the compound polysaccharide prepared by the invention is used for aquaculture, the immunocompetence and the antioxidation capability of aquatic organisms can be obviously improved, the survival rate can be improved, the growth of the aquatic organisms can be promoted, the use is safe, and the aquatic organisms are free from obvious liver injury and the like.

title: Preparation method of filamentous yeast-like fungus fermentation product
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a filamentous yeast-like fungus fermentation product, and relates to the field of fungus fermentation. The filtrate of the fermentation product of the filamentous yeast-like fungi after multiple fermentation has higher cell safety and better product effect. The method adopts filamentous yeast-like fungi and pure natural culture medium prepared from matsutake, white willow bark, ganoderma lucidum, white truffle or rice to carry out multiple fermentation, namely, the sediment in the primary fermentation product is used for the culture medium component of the secondary fermentation, so that the cell safety can be improved, the skin care effect of the fermentation product can be improved, the cost can be saved, and the method is suitable for production and manufacture. The fermented product has good skin care effect, and can be applied to cosmetics.

title: Porous silicon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a porous silicon material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Melt mixing a silicon source and a lithium source to obtain a melt mixture; (2) Carrying out lithium removal on the molten mixture to obtain a lithium removal product; (3) And carrying out heat treatment on the lithium removal product to obtain the porous silicon material. The invention provides a preparation method with low cost, simple process and low energy consumption, and the formed silicon nano-sheets can be radially arranged in honeycomb shape in all directions of particles through lithium attachment and lithium removal to form a controllable isotropic channelized porous silicon structure. The porous silicon material prepared based on the method not only can adapt to the volume change of silicon, but also can obviously promote the rapid transmission of lithium ions, so that the material utilization and capacity exertion are not limited by particle orientation, and the porous silicon material has high surface capacity, high rate performance and excellent cycling stability, has good industrial application prospect, and can realize large-scale production.

title: Preparation method and application of modified copper hydroxide material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a modified copper hydroxide material, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing Cu (OH) 2 Dispersed in a solvent containing isopropyl alcohol (C) 2 Adding Nafion (perfluorosulfonic acid) into a mixed solution of PrOH, Tetrahydrofuran (THF) and multi-wall Carbon Nanotubes (CNTs) for physical mixing to obtain the modified copper hydroxide material (Cu (OH) 2 @ Nafion). Using the modified copper hydroxide material (Cu (OH) 2 @ Nafion) for catalyzing CO in a fluidized electrolytic cell 2 The reduction reaction shows higher multi-carbon product selectivity (the faradaic efficiency of ethylene reaches 44 percent) and better catalytic stability (the stable running time is up to 8000 s), and solves the problem of hydrophilicityThe copper hydroxide material can not be well utilized in the flowing electrolytic bath.

title: Modified hydrogel adsorbent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a modified hydrogel adsorbent, a preparation method and applications thereof, the preparation method comprising the steps of: (1) Mixing a first polymer solution with an acid solution to obtain a solution A, mixing a second polymer, a cross-linking agent and a solvent to obtain a solution B, mixing the solution A and the solution B to obtain a mixed solution, adding a lithium ion sieve to obtain a pre-polymerized solution, and carrying out freezing treatment after reaction to obtain a hydrogel adsorbent; (2) And mixing the linear polymer monomer and the initiator to obtain a modified precursor solution, mixing the hydrogel adsorbent and the modified precursor solution, and carrying out light reaction to obtain the modified hydrogel adsorbent. The method has the advantages that the adsorbent/ion sieve is wrapped in the hydrogel, the hydrogel adsorbent with good mechanical stability is prepared, the impurity ion level in the adsorbent is constant, the lithium extraction method for concentrating brine by utilizing illumination can be realized, lithium is extracted while concentration is carried out, and byproduct salt is obtained, and no additional concentration step is needed.

title: Silicon dioxide combined material, application and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a silicon dioxide composite material, application and a preparation method thereof, wherein the silicon dioxide composite material is prepared by mixing water with an auxiliary material A in a certain proportion to prepare a homogeneous solution M, adding the homogeneous solution M into gas phase nano silicon dioxide to obtain a primary raw material, kneading the primary raw material at a certain rotating speed to obtain a mixed material, judging the state of the material, adjusting the proportion according to the state of the material, and discharging the mixed material which accords with the state of the material. Under the action of external forces such as shearing, impact and the like, the mixture can generate intelligent mechanical response, the material is changed from a fluid state to a solid state, and the strength and the hardness are increased; when external forces such as shearing, impact and the like are removed, intelligent mechanical response can occur again, the material is changed from a solid state to a fluid state, and the strength and the hardness can be weakened; the preparation material can effectively absorb impact force, can be applied to the fields of intelligent shock absorption, intelligent impact prevention, intelligent protection and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title: Nanometer material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a nano material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, connecting a graphite molded body and a conductive object which are respectively connected with a positive electrode and a negative electrode of a direct current power supply, placing the graphite molded body and the conductive object in electrolyte containing organic alkali, electrolyzing for 1-10 days under the voltage of 25-50V to obtain a first mixture containing carbon points and the organic alkali, S2, mixing a silicon source and an active center source, carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the obtained mixture and the first mixture to obtain a second mixture, S3, cooling the obtained reaction product, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a solid-phase product and a liquid-phase product, roasting the solid-phase product to obtain the nano material, and S4, enabling the liquid-phase product to be in contact with a porous material, wherein the pore size of the porous material is larger than that of the nano material. The nano material prepared by the method not only has better catalytic reaction activity, but also can directly discharge the wastewater generated in the preparation process.

title: Information processing method, device and equipment
abstract: The application discloses an information processing method, device and equipment, belonging to the technical field of communication, wherein the information processing method disclosed by the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: the first communication device obtains first information from the second communication device; and the first communication equipment executes a first operation according to the first information, wherein the first operation is used for managing the local network, and the first communication equipment and the second communication equipment are network entities deployed in the local network.

title: Data transmission system and method based on Internet of things
abstract: The application discloses a data transmission system and a data transmission method based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of data transmission of equipment of the Internet of things and comprise the following steps: the receiving end of the server receives first collected data distributed in the temporary storage space; establishing a plurality of groups of transmission channels, and determining a communication mode between the transmission channels and the temporary storage space in the first acquired data transmission process; feeding back the communication mode determined in the first acquired data transmission process to a transmission end in a binary signal mode; and judging the switching frequency in the data transmission process according to the stored binary signal, and selecting the verification mode of the receiving end according to the switching frequency. In the implementation process of the technical scheme of the application, the effect of adjusting the transmission channels according to the data is realized by establishing a plurality of groups of transmission channels and determining the communication mode of the transmission channels and the temporary storage space, the transmission efficiency of the data is improved, the communication mode in the transmission process is stored in the form of binary signals, and the verification mode of the receiving end is adjusted.

title: Apparatus, computer readable medium, and method for changing service using advanced data collection capability
abstract: A method for presenting services to a subscriber includes a specific process. The method includes collecting usage data associated with an account of a subscriber associated with a portable device. The method includes storing the usage data in an information repository. The method includes determining whether the usage data satisfies a condition. The method includes determining whether there is data for an actionable category. The method includes determining an action based on the actionable category of data and a set of rules. The method includes receiving a first message from a portable device, the first message indicating that a communication function of the portable device has terminated. The method includes sending a second message to the portable device, the second message requesting input from the subscriber via the portable device, and the second message being based on an action. The method includes receiving a third message from the portable device, the third message including a response to the second message.

title: Communication method, communication device and communication system
abstract: The application provides a communication method, a communication device and a communication system. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving first indication information from the network device, the first indication information being used to indicate whether the packet data convergence protocol (packet data convergence protocol, PDCP) discards the data unit; if the first indication indicates PDCP discard data unit, discarding PDCP data unit and re-establishing radio link control (radio link control, RLC). By the technical scheme provided by the application, the performance of the terminal equipment in cell switching can be improved.

title: Information transmitting and receiving method and device, communication device and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an information transmitting and receiving method and device, a communication device, and a storage medium, wherein the information transmitting method includes: and sending first indication information to a network element of a core network, wherein the first indication information is used for indicating the communication device to determine information of an artificial intelligent model used by the position related information of the terminal. According to the method and the device, the communication device can send the first indication information to the network element of the core network, the communication device is indicated to determine the information of the artificial intelligent model used by the position related information of the terminal through the first indication information, so that the network element of the core network can timely learn the artificial intelligent model used by the communication device, and proper management is further carried out on the artificial intelligent model.

title: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title: Method and device for machine monitoring, and computer program product for machine monitoring
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for machine monitoring and to a computer program product for machine monitoring. According to the invention, the image data captured with the aid of at least one camera and any additionally collected measurement data are time-limited using the image data captured with the aid of a trigger camera and evaluated for the presence of a trigger event such that only the relevant time range of the image data and, if applicable, measurement data has to be stored and analysed. This saves both time and hardware resources. In further advantageous embodiments of the invention, time synchronisation of different (image) data sources, a colour filter function, and/or a master-frame comparison for recognising faults are implemented.

title: Intra-frame prediction method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and product
abstract: The present disclosure provides an intra-frame prediction method, an intra-frame prediction device, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a product.
