The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-dimensional characteristic data of a current coding unit, wherein the multi-dimensional characteristic data are used for representing texture characteristics and time domain coding rules of the current coding unit, performing mode analysis on the multi-dimensional characteristic data by utilizing a target classification model to obtain an angle prediction mode classification result corresponding to the current coding unit, determining a candidate angle prediction mode set according to the angle prediction mode classification result, determining a target angle prediction mode from the candidate angle prediction mode set to complete intra-frame prediction, and combining accurate mode analysis of the target classification model to achieve efficient screening of the candidate angle prediction mode set, so that the traversing quantity of the prediction modes is greatly reduced, the calculation complexity is reduced, and coding delay is further shortened.

title: Event detection method and electronic equipment
abstract: The application discloses an event detection method and electronic equipment, which are used for improving event detection efficiency. The event detection method comprises the steps of determining at least one frame of collected image acquired for a monitored target scene, detecting markers of the image by a deep learning network based on the at least one frame of collected image, determining image position information of at least one marker, determining an image detection area of an event by utilizing the image position information of the at least one marker, and detecting the event for pedestrians in the image detection area. The technical scheme provided by the application has the characteristics of real-time performance, reproducibility and controllability, and accords with the reliability.

title: Detection enhancement method, system, equipment and medium for industrial equipment
abstract: The application relates to a detection enhancement method, a detection enhancement system, detection enhancement equipment and detection enhancement media for industrial equipment. The method comprises the steps of injecting all sensor data in each sampling period into the same global frame sequence number and a high-precision acquisition time stamp to obtain an original synchronous data frame, carrying out signal conditioning on the original synchronous data frame to generate an atomic transmission unit based on the constant constraint of the global frame sequence number and the high-precision acquisition time stamp, storing a reconstructed sensor data frame into a synchronous frame queue according to the ascending sequence of the global frame sequence number, carrying out time alignment decision according to the high-precision acquisition time stamp and the target presentation time corresponding to the reconstructed sensor data frame at the head of the synchronous frame queue to obtain a reconstructed sensor data frame to be rendered currently, carrying out time interpolation calculation based on the reconstructed sensor data frame to be rendered in combination with the previous visual rendering cycle, and generating a synchronous rendering data set. By adopting the method, cross-platform data synchronous visual presentation can be realized.

title: Fastening device for processing machine tool
abstract: The invention discloses a fastening device for a processing machine tool, which comprises a floating assembly, a clamping assembly and a cylinder assembly, wherein the floating assembly comprises an installation frame, a fixed plate arranged on the installation frame, a first optical axis arranged between the installation frame and the fixed plate and a vertical spring sleeved outside the first optical axis; the clamping assembly is arranged on the mounting frame and comprises a pressing plate, a left clamping seat and a right clamping plate, wherein the left clamping seat and the right clamping plate are arranged on two sides of the pressing plate; the air cylinder assembly comprises an air cylinder mounting seat, an air cylinder arranged on the air cylinder mounting seat and an air cylinder connecting seat connected with the air cylinder; the fastening device provided by the invention provides a functional taking and placing fastening device which is matched with a robot or a three-coordinate device for use, the gripper has the advantages of up-and-down floating, workpiece pressing and left-and-right floating, a double-cylinder floating device is adopted for clamping, certain deviation can be allowed during gripping, a machining machine tool can be quickly modified through connecting devices such as a hanging ring, and the fastening device has high universality under different modification conditions.

title: Automobile generator end cover machining, clamping and positioning device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machining tools and discloses an automobile generator end cover machining clamping and positioning device which comprises a machining table, wherein a rotating table is arranged on the machining table, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the center of the bottom of the rotating table, a first limiting mechanism for fixing a center hole of an end cover is arranged in the rotating shaft, a round hole for extending out of the first limiting mechanism is formed in the upper surface of the rotating table, a supporting seat is fixedly connected to one side of the machining table, a lifting seat is slidably connected to the supporting seat in the vertical direction, a second limiting mechanism for fixing an end cover mounting lug is arranged on the lifting seat, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to one side of the lifting seat in the vertical direction, a third limiting mechanism for clamping and fixing two side edges of the end cover is arranged at the bottom of the connecting rod, and a control mechanism for controlling the third limiting mechanism to turn over 180 DEG is arranged on the supporting seat. The invention can restrict the vibration generated by the end cover during processing, prevent the end cover from moving upwards during the rotation processing of the end cover, ensure the clamping stability and ensure the processing effect.

title: Reinforcing steel bar conveying device
abstract: The invention discloses a steel bar conveying device which comprises a frame, a receiving mechanism, a turnover mechanism and a conveying mechanism, wherein the frame is horizontally arranged left and right; the material receiving mechanism comprises support columns, connecting columns, material receiving assemblies and guide plates, wherein each two support columns are vertically arranged on the front side and the rear side of the top surface of the frame in a group, and a plurality of groups are arranged at intervals along the left-right horizontal direction; the two connecting columns are arranged in the left-right horizontal direction, and the bottom surfaces of the two connecting columns are fixedly connected with the top surfaces of the supporting columns on the front side and the rear side of the top of the frame respectively; the material receiving components are respectively arranged on the connecting columns through the turnover mechanisms; the guide plates are vertically arranged on one side of each group of support columns, one side of each guide plate is inclined downwards, and the other side of each guide plate is arranged at intervals to form a blanking channel; the conveying mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top surface of the frame. The invention has high degree of automation, time and labor saving, labor cost saving, production efficiency improvement and good application prospect.

title: Welding device and positioning fixture
abstract: The invention provides a welding device and a positioning clamp, wherein the positioning clamp comprises two movable tables, the top of each movable table is provided with a top plate, the two movable tables are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of a partition plate respectively, clamping assemblies are arranged on the top plates of the two movable tables, the output end of a rotary driving mechanism is connected with the center of the bottom of the partition plate, a material guiding inclined plate is fixedly arranged on the top plate of the movable table, the height of the top surface of the material guiding inclined plate is gradually reduced along the direction deviating from the partition plate, a knocking mechanism is used for knocking the material guiding inclined plate, the bottom surface of the material guiding inclined plate and the top surface of the top plate of the movable table enclose a separation cavity, and the knocking mechanism is arranged in the separation cavity. The welding device comprises a welding part, wherein the welding part is arranged on one side of the positioning clamp, and the welding part comprises a mechanical arm and a welding gun arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm. The welding device has the advantages that the two groups of clamping assemblies are used alternately, the welding efficiency is improved, and the arrangement of the material guiding inclined plate and the knocking mechanism is convenient for automatically removing scraps on the table top.

title: Mechanical part clamping device for mechanical engineering
abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical accessory clamping device for mechanical engineering, and belongs to the technical field of clamping. A mechanical part clamping device for mechanical engineering comprises a base, wherein the outer wall of the base is fixedly connected with a box body, a driving mechanism and a gas collecting mechanism are arranged in the box body, the inner wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a partition plate and a stabilizer bar, a first avoidance groove is formed in the box body, a first screw rod and a second screw rod are rotationally connected to the box body, a first belt wheel and a second bevel gear are fixedly connected to the first screw rod, a second belt wheel and a third bevel gear are fixedly connected to the second screw rod, fixing blocks are in threaded connection with the first screw rod and the second screw rod, the fixing blocks are connected to the stabilizer bar in a sliding mode, the thread directions of the first screw rod and the second screw rod are opposite, and a clamping mechanism is arranged at the top of each fixing block; the automatic clamping device is simple to operate, can automatically clamp the accessories, can clean the accessories in the clamping and loosening processes, greatly saves labor and time, and improves production efficiency.

title: Polynucleotides and methods for transferring resistance to asian soybean rust
abstract: Disclosed herein are compostions and methods for improving or enhancing pathogen resistance in legume plants. Compositions comprising polypeptides encoded by legume-derived nucleotide-binding site-leucine rich repeat (NB-LRR) ne are useful in improving resistance in legumes to Asian soybean rust. Methods of using NB-LRR genes can be used to make a transgenic resistant legume plant.

title: Compounds and methods for the enhanced degradation of targeted proteins
abstract: The present invention relates to bifunctional compounds, which find utility as modulators of targeted ubiquitination, especially inhibitors of a variety of polypeptides and other proteins which are degraded and/or otherwise inhibited by bifunctional compounds according to the present invention. In particular, the present invention is directed to compounds, which contain on one end a VHL ligand which binds to the ubiquitin ligase and on the other end a moiety which binds a target protein such that the target protein is placed in proximity to the ubiquitin ligase to effect degradation (and inhibition) of that protein. The present invention exhibits a broad range of pharmacological activities associated with compounds according to the present invention, consistent with the degradation/inhibition of targeted polypeptides.

title: Compositions and methods for reducing hydrogen sulfide and microbial influenced corrosion in crude oil, natural gas, and in associated equipment
abstract: The present invention provides compositions and methods for reducing hydrogen sulfide and/or mercaptans in oil and/or natural gas as well as for reducing microbial induced corrosion ("MIC") in oil and gas production environments. In particular, the subject invention provides environmentally-friendly compositions and methods for reducing hydrogen sulfide in oil and natural gas environments by controlling biocorrosive bacteria, such as SRB, therein.

title: Graphene/copper composite deformed copper-chromium-zirconium alloy layered strip material, and preparation method therefor
abstract: A graphene/copper composite deformed copper-chromium-zirconium alloy layered strip material and a preparation method therefor. An embodiment comprises: first carrying out ambient temperature equal channel angular pressing (ECAP) and cryogenic rolling (CR) on a block-shaped copper-chromium-zirconium alloy having undergone solution treatment; then performing electrodeposition treatment for graphene composited with copper on copper-chromium-zirconium alloy strip material having undergone deformation; then stacking the composite strip material and performing cold rolling, obtaining a layered strip material, and finally performing vacuum aging treatment. The composite material has an electrical conductivity reaching 75-85 % IACS, a tensile strength reaching 600-850 MPa, a thermal conductivity reaching 600-1200 W/m-K, a percentage elongation at break reaching 10-20%, and said composite material fulfills usage in the fields of electrical conduction and heat transfer.

title: Integrated relay valve with ABS electromagnetic valve assembly
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of vehicle braking systems, and discloses an integrated relay valve with an ABS electromagnetic valve assembly, wherein a valve cavity is arranged in a valve body of the integrated relay valve with the ABS electromagnetic valve assembly, the relay valve assembly is arranged in the valve cavity, the integrated relay valve with the ABS electromagnetic valve assembly further comprises a piston group, the piston group comprises a first piston and a second piston, a control port (40) is arranged on the valve body, the control port (40) is communicated with the valve cavity, the upper side of the first piston is a cavity I, the lower side of the second piston is a cavity II, the first piston is abutted against the upper end of the second piston, and the lower end of the second piston is used for controlling the opening and closing of the relay valve assembly; the first piston and the second piston are in sealing contact with the inner wall of the valve cavity; compressed air of the control port (40) can push the second piston to axially slide by pushing the first piston, and the second piston can axially move to push the relay valve assembly to work; the outer diameter of the second piston is smaller than the outer diameter of the first piston. The assembly can design the pressure ratio of the control port (40) to the air outlet to be 1 to 1.5 according to the requirement, so that the pressure can be built more quickly and the response is faster.
